construction: Four forcing profiles times three motion families times three independent scenario replicas; two replicas for training and one for development in each family/motion cell. Each scenario has independently varied initial state and force parameters.
density_assignment: Balance density margins within each split; audit joint density/shape/forcing coverage rather than claiming a full Cartesian product.
grid_assignment: Retain small grids and distribute larger cubic/rectangular and rotated-aspect domains; pilot32cubed and moderate rectangular cases before expensive larger volumes.
initial_state_variation: initial velocity structure where native capture supports it
force amplitude, position, radius and motion path
pulse timing, duty and irregular events; continuous variance
split_unit: physical_scenario_group_id: all timestep views, trajectory continuations, replicas of the same realization and related rescaled captures stay in the same split.
independent_seed_rule: Replicas are independent physical realizations, not copies of one trajectory with different sample spacing.
resource_admission: Measure capture time, memory and retained-window disk costs on the four-scene pilot; freeze the finite full manifest and storage budget from those measurements before broad capture.
regular_pulse_correction_gap: Current29active correction scenes contain no regular-pulse examples. Expansion must supply informative temporal-correction windows across all four force families; unchanged controls are reported separately.
